description: Vendor rates used to price a bake-off run. VERIFY against the vendor pricing pages before a scored run: voice pricing changes often, and the issue budgets about $11 of API spend for the whole bake-off. Rates marked verified:false are estimates, not vendor quotes. Gemini Live bills per token and re-bills the whole session context on every turn, so the fresh-audio meter below UNDERSTATES a long session; the runner reports the meter estimate and the session length together so the re-billing is visible.

cascade.source: Deepgram Nova-3 streaming PAYG ($0.0077/min) and Cartesia Sonic (~$37/1M chars) via secondary summaries checked 2026-11-11; Gemini 2.5 Flash text rates are an estimate, NOT verified against Google's page.

gemini.source: Google Gemini Developer API pricing page, via secondary summaries checked 2026-11-11 (audio in $0.005/min, out $0.018/min).

grok.source: xAI Grok Voice 3.0 list price, via secondary summary checked 2026-11-11 ($0.08/min).
